title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: A crystal‑clear matrix recording captures a high‑energy Garden show highlighted by a smoking Shakedown Street, killer Dupree’s Diamond Blues and Brent Mydland’s playful keyboard leadership.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as charged from the opening Shakedown Street through an inspired second set with tight versions of Scarlet > Fire, Terrapin Station and a soaring Spanish Jam > Truckin' > Other One. The matrix source blends board crispness with audience ambience, delivering excellent sound quality that lets Brent’s playful keys and Jerry’s guitar work shine.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are overwhelmingly positive (mostly 5‑star) highlighting both an exceptional show and an excellent matrix recording, giving strong weight to the musical performance while confirming top‑tier technical quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note crisp board clarity combined with audience energy, describing it as the best of both worlds with no noticeable dropouts or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set opens with a fiery Shakedown Street and maintains momentum through strong mid‑set jams, delivering tight second‑set pairings and a satisfying Spanish Jam/Truckin'/Other One sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work is highlighted, especially the strumming at the end of Good Times and overall strong tone throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland receives consistent praise for being “right on target,” playful, and leading the band’s energy from the opening notes onward.
